intro: Atlanta's public sauna scene is centered on the Korean spas (jjimjilbang) of Gwinnett County and the Buford Highway corridor, roughly 15-25 miles northeast of downtown. Jeju Sauna and Spa Land in Duluth, Gangnam Sauna in Norcross and Roman Holiday Sauna in Doraville all sell walk-in day admission covering mineral-stone sauna rooms, steam and gender-separated bath areas, and three of the four are open around the clock. A communal Nordic-style sauna club for intown Atlanta (Atlanta Sauna Club) has announced plans for 2027 but has no site yet.

venues.name: Jeju Sauna
venues.address: 3555 Gwinnett Pl Dr NW, Duluth, GA 30096
venues.session_length: Wristband key active for 24 hours; no re-entry
venues.cold_plunge: Unknown (bath areas have temperature-controlled tubs; a dedicated cold tub is not stated on the venue's site)
venues.schedule: Saunas and bathhouse open 24/7 including all holidays; other services have shorter hours. No appointments, first come first served. Gender-separated bathing areas require full nudity; spa uniform provided for shared areas. Barefoot facility.
venues.notes: Large Korean bathhouse with natural mineral-stone sauna rooms including salt and rock rooms, steam rooms, traditional baths, a heated jade-stone pool, a junior Olympic swimming pool (bring your own swimsuit; none provided) and a fitness room. A physical government-issued photo ID is required (paper copies refused); a $100 cash deposit is accepted instead. Food, scrubs and massages are charged to the wristband and paid at checkout; complimentary toiletries.

venues.name: Spa Land & Sauna (Spa Land Georgia)
venues.address: 2645 N Berkeley Lake Rd NW, Building C, Duluth, GA 30096
venues.cold_plunge: Cold tubs on the men's and women's floors (temperature Unknown)
venues.schedule: Mon-Thu 9am-12am; Fri-Sun and holidays 9am-2am the next day (closed overnight for cleaning). Separate men's and women's floors plus a co-ed jjimjilbang floor. Body scrubs 9am-9:30pm daily. Walk-in policy for admission Unknown.
venues.notes: Men's and women's floors each have hot and cold tubs, steam and dry saunas, treatment stations and showers; the co-ed floor has specialty mineral saunas. On-site food court with shorter hours. Scrubs from $60 and massages cost extra.

venues.name: Gangnam Sauna
venues.drop_in_price: $30 general admission at the front office; $20 seniors; $15 children
venues.schedule: Open 24/7 per the venue's site; restaurant 9am-11pm. Children under 4 not admitted. Bath-area dress rules Unknown.
venues.notes: Family-friendly Korean jjimjilbang with hot and cold baths and clay, salt, jade, charcoal and ice rooms, a full-service restaurant, an open-air terrace and a kids' zone. Body scrubs from $60 and other spa services cost extra.

venues.name: Roman Holiday Sauna
venues.address: 5979 Buford Hwy NE, Suite B7, Doraville, GA 30340
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown on the venue's site (its prices page was not loading on 2026-11-23); a third-party guide listed a $35 general day pass, $25 online, in Sept 2026
venues.schedule: Open 24/7/365. Walk-ins welcome, no appointment required (waits possible at peak times and holidays). Shoes removed inside. No outside food or drink; no alcohol or smoking.
venues.notes: Korean jjimjilbang with a dry sauna, steam room, charcoal room, Himalayan salt room and red clay room, plus hot tubs, showers and relaxation areas. Day pass includes towels and a locker; complimentary water and tea; on-site restaurant and K-Cafe. Body scrubs, massage, facials and nail services cost extra.
